items.title: Rename package metadata for published packages
items.context: Change package.json and package-lock names/dependencies from @koala-agent/* to @lattice-agent/* for core/utils/lab/cli packages, and update root package identity where it exposes Koala branding. Keep the lattice binary primary and preserve koala bin aliases only as legacy compatibility.

items.title: Update runtime and bootstrap package resolution
items.context: Runtime checks, worktree relink, init bootstrap, prompt registry, rollout checks, and generated local wrappers currently hard-code @koala-agent/core paths. Update them to resolve @lattice-agent/core as canonical while treating @koala-agent/core as legacy fallback only where existing projects need compatibility.

items.title: Refresh docs and verification contract references
items.context: User-facing and process docs should stop presenting @koala-agent/core as the canonical package name. Update active truth-source docs and verification scripts that assert old package names, without touching docs/story or fixture JSON directly.

items.title: Verify package rename behavior
items.context: Run targeted package metadata checks, TypeScript/build verification, existing runtime contract verification scripts, and lattice validate so the rename does not break local wrappers, lab registration, or runtime environment diagnostics.
